title: Ledger at a Glance
description: Dispatch wants a quick chart of shipment volume and revenue over time. Book a couple of shipments and confirm the summary endpoint's totals actually add up.
successCondition: GET /api/reporting/summary?from=&to=&groupBy=day&timeZone=UTC returns 200 with totalShipments equal to the number of shipments booked in that window, and totalRevenueCents equal to the sum of their priceCents.
hints: from/to are ISO datetimes — see docs/api/reporting.md for the exact inclusive/exclusive range semantics.
